baslik: GTA 6 is out. Which console does AI tell you to buy? #shorts
aciklama:
We asked ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini the same 8 GTA 6 console questions from the US (Nov 21, 2026).

• PS5 Pro was the top pick for the best GTA 6 experience in 6 of 6 answers.
• Ask about Black Friday or a Christmas gift and Nintendo Switch 2, which can't run GTA 6, becomes the top pick.
• Gemini, answering from memory, said GTA 6 isn't out yet in 10 answers.

These are the AI's answers, not our recommendation. Small sample, not representative of the whole market.
